items.problem: Validator invoked via a bare relative backslash path parsed by PowerShell as a module-qualified command; the script never ran yet $LASTEXITCODE stayed 0 ('VALIDATE_EXIT=0'), so an exit-code check falsely reads success and the mandatory validation gate can be silently skipped.
items.evidence: notes/lessons.json errors_encountered[1]; session-log.txt turn 4 lines 4617-4623 ('The module '.github' could not be loaded' + 'VALIDATE_EXIT=0'), recovered turn 5 with absolute path.
items.root_cause: SKILL.md shows '& "<skill-root>/scripts/X.ps1"' but never requires an absolute path nor warns that a relative 'dir\script.ps1' is parsed as a module-qualified command that fails without changing $LASTEXITCODE.
items.change: Added a prominent invocation rule under the Process script list: resolve <skill-root> to an absolute path (or '.\' prefix); a bare relative backslash path fails as a module-qualified command without setting $LASTEXITCODE; confirm the script actually ran instead of trusting the exit code.
items.expected_effect: Agents invoke the four skill scripts with absolute paths and verify execution, so the mandatory Validate-UwpMigration gate can no longer be silently skipped by a false-pass exit code.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, no 'The module '...' could not be loaded' error appears, the validator's PASS/FAIL header is present in output, and the agent does not declare done off a stale $LASTEXITCODE. Tier 3 prose was required because the scripts cannot control how a caller types their own invocation path.

items.problem: CS8618 nullable warnings on the migrated SDK-sample model class (SampleConfiguration.cs 'Scenario', non-nullable auto-properties) under the scaffold's <Nullable>enable</Nullable>, costing a diagnose+fix cycle.
items.evidence: notes/lessons.json errors_encountered[0]; session-log.txt turns 1-3 lines 4552-4610 ('4 Warning(s)' all CS8618, fixed with default initializers).
items.root_cause: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Common build errors after the namespace rewrite' lists CS0104/CS0227/CS0101/CS0246 but not CS8618, which the nullable-enabled scaffold always emits for verbatim-copied non-nullable model classes.
items.change: Added a CS8618 subsection under 'Common build errors after the namespace rewrite' naming the cause (non-nullable auto-props copied into the nullable-enabled scaffold; SampleConfiguration.cs / ControlInfoData idiom) and the one-line fix (initialize or make nullable).
items.expected_effect: Agents recognize and fix CS8618 on migrated model classes in one pass without a separate diagnose turn, keeping the validator's warning count at zero.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, CS8618 on model/config classes is fixed in the same edit pass (no dedicated diagnose turn) and the validator reports 0 warnings. Tier 3 was chosen over disabling <Nullable> (a template/Tier-2 change we do not own and which would mask real null-safety issues).

deferred_to_human: Original UWP app hung on its splash screen during scoring so no live golden baseline was captured — an eval/environment (Tier 0) condition in uwp-app-runner/parity capture, out of scope for the migration skill.
